title: Quaint Baked Ukrainian Fiordilatte Lasagna
description: A festive Ukrainian dish featuring fiordilatte cheese, this lasagna is baked to perfection in a talavera plate, offering a unique blend of bitter and cheesy flavors. It is a raw-friendly and salt-baked recipe.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
In a talavera plate, create a thin layer of marinara sauce on the bottom.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles.
Add a layer of sliced fiordilatte cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the marinara sauce, the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, and finally another layer of fiordilatte cheese.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top layer of cheese.
Cover the talavera plate with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
